examples.english: To write with the right hand.

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}と{左|ひだり}を{見|み}てから{渡|わた}る。
examples.english: Look right and left before crossing.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}はあの{建物|たてもの}の{右|みぎ}にあります。
examples.english: The bank is to the right of that building.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}をまっすぐ{行|い}って、{二|ふた}つ{目|め}の{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: Go straight down this road and turn right at the second corner.

notes:
{右|みぎ} indicates the right direction, opposite of {左|ひだり}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn right
- {右|みぎ}を{見|み}る: to look right
- {右|みぎ}から{左|ひだり}へ: from right to left (also: in one ear and out the other)

COMPOUNDS:
- {右手|みぎて}: right hand
- {右足|みぎあし}: right foot/leg
- {右側|みぎがわ}: right side
- {右折|うせつ}: right turn (traffic term)
- {右利|みぎき}き: right-handed

POLITICAL USAGE:
{右|みぎ}/{右翼|うよく} can mean "right-wing" in political contexts.

OPPOSITE:
{左|ひだり}: left
